title: Companies and the people who founded them

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

founder.match: Match each company to its founder.

rows.label: YouTube
rows.founder: Chad Hurley, Steve Chen and Jawed Karim
rows.description: American video-sharing platform owned by Alphabet Inc.
rows.hook: grew from a video-sharing startup into the world's most-watched video site

rows.label: Instagram
rows.description: photo and video sharing social network owned by Meta Platforms
rows.hook: turned everyday photos into filtered, shareable square snapshots

rows.label: Google
rows.description: American multinational technology company, a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc.
rows.hook: became the world's go-to tool for searching the internet

rows.label: Apple
rows.founder: Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne
rows.description: American multinational technology company based in Cupertino, California
rows.hook: makes the iPhone along with popular, minimalist-designed laptops

rows.label: Microsoft
rows.description: American multinational technology corporation
rows.hook: created the software running on most of the world's personal computers

rows.label: Netflix
rows.description: American subscription video on-demand over-the-top streaming service
rows.hook: went from mailing DVDs to streaming shows worldwide

rows.label: Nvidia
rows.founder: Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem
rows.description: American multinational technology company
rows.hook: makes the graphics chips that power video games and modern AI

rows.label: Studio Ghibli
rows.founder: Hayao Miyazaki, Isao Takahata, Toshio Suzuki and Yasuyoshi Tokuma
rows.description: Japanese animation studio
rows.hook: created beloved animated films featuring magical forests and flying castles

rows.label: Nike
rows.description: American athletic equipment company
rows.hook: makes the swoosh-logo sneakers worn by athletes worldwide

rows.label: Spotify
rows.description: Swedish audio streaming service
rows.hook: lets listeners stream millions of songs and podcasts on demand

rows.label: Sony
rows.description: Japanese multinational conglomerate corporation
rows.hook: makes the PlayStation game console and a wide range of electronics

rows.label: Valve
rows.description: American video game development and digital distribution company
rows.hook: runs the biggest digital storefront for PC video games

rows.label: Samsung
rows.description: South Korean multinational conglomerate
rows.hook: makes the Galaxy smartphones and a vast range of consumer electronics

rows.label: Yahoo
rows.description: web portal and search engine
rows.hook: ran one of the earliest popular web search portals and email services

rows.label: Red Bull
rows.description: brand of energy drinks sold by Red Bull GmbH
rows.hook: sponsors extreme sports and a Formula 1 racing team

rows.label: eBay
rows.description: American multinational internet corporation that manages eBay.com
rows.hook: lets people buy and sell almost anything through online auctions

rows.label: IKEA
rows.description: Swedish multinational furniture store chain
rows.hook: sells flatpack furniture and is famous for meatballs served in its cafeteria

rows.label: KFC
rows.description: American fast food restaurant chain specializing in fried chicken
rows.hook: serves fried chicken under a bow-tied, white-suited mascot's smiling face

rows.label: Electronic Arts
rows.description: American video game company
rows.hook: publishes hit sports and life-simulation video games

rows.label: Motown
rows.description: American record label
rows.hook: launched the soulful sound that defined a generation of hit records

rows.label: Airbnb
rows.founder: Brian Chesky, Joe Gebbia and Nathan Blecharczyk
rows.description: American online platform for rental accommodations
rows.hook: lets travelers book stays in other people's homes worldwide

rows.label: Intel
rows.description: American multinational technology company
rows.hook: makes the processor chips found inside countless personal computers

rows.label: DreamWorks
rows.founder: Steven Spielberg, Jeffrey Katzenberg and David Geffen
rows.description: American film studio
rows.hook: makes animated blockbusters featuring an ogre and a kung fu panda

rows.label: Puma
rows.description: German multinational corporation
rows.hook: sells sporty sneakers and gear branded with a leaping wildcat

rows.label: Wendy's
rows.description: American international fast food chain restaurant
rows.hook: serves square hamburger patties under a red-haired mascot's grin

rows.label: Uniqlo
rows.description: Japanese casual wear designer, manufacturer and retailer
rows.hook: sells simple, affordable everyday clothing basics worldwide

rows.label: Zara
rows.description: retailer for clothing and perfumes, headquartered in Spain
rows.hook: turns runway trends into store racks within just weeks

rows.label: Virgin Group
rows.description: British multinational branded venture capital conglomerate
rows.hook: spans airlines, music and even spaceflight under one adventurous brand

rows.label: Atari
rows.description: brand name owned by Atari Interactive
rows.hook: pioneered classic arcade and home video games in gaming's early days

rows.label: Lego
rows.description: Danish toy manufacturer best known for interlocking-brick construction toys
rows.hook: makes colorful interlocking bricks kids snap together to build anything

rows.label: Patagonia
rows.description: American clothing company
rows.hook: makes outdoor gear and pledges its profits to fighting climate change
